blocks.html:
Dodge Caravan 2020 – Commercial Decals

There is never a wrong time to give back to the community and extend a helping hand to those in need. With the whole world fighting the pandemic, a lot of our soldiers have fallen down and it is our duty as humans to help them get back up and stand against the great reset.

There are community services dedicated to helping the needy but oftentimes people who are in need don’t have the resources to discover where these community services are located. In order to spread the word so our brothers and sisters who need help can locate these services, it is required to promote the service in a way that is accessible to everyone.

Vinyl Wrap Toronto recently had the pleasure of installing promotional decals for community service “The Salvation Army” which accept donations and uses them towards feeding and providing necessities to those in need. To be able to raise more money for these people, the people at The Salvation Army wanted to spread the word about what they were doing. It was a smart thing to do now, especially with the pandemic going on.

They chose to install a few minimal vehicle decals on their Dodge Caravan 2020 to make people aware of their existence and what they do for the less fortunate. We took the Dodge Caravan in a heartbeat and took great pleasure in doing the job. It felt like we were doing our part to give back to the community.

The client(s) wanted a couple of promotional decals on the sides and the back. The decals feature their logo, address, phone number, and website. That covers all the information one would need to reach out to them. It was an initiative to attract both donors as well as people in need.

Having years of experience, we installed the decals on the Dodge Caravan 2020 in no time and we’re grateful that we were able to contribute to this noble cause.

We’ve attached some pictures of the Dodge Caravan on this page for you to see what the decals look like.

Most of our clients choose to go with decals/ vinyl stickers due to the following reasons:

  1. The target audience doesn’t need a device or service to see your ad.
  2. It is a non-aggressive way to advertise.
  3. Vinyl Stickers last for years.
  4. Decals are cost-effective based on their lifespan.
  5. Vinyl Stickers are environment-friendly.
  6. Decals are customizable, the design, colour, and finish, allow you to turn anything into a 2D decal.
  7. Easily removable

If you wish to get decals to promote your business, feel free to reach out to our team at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to our experts about your requirements.

To read more stories, visit our blog page. Check out more of our work here.
